{{Color box|{{party color|Partidong Pagbabago ng Palawan}}|border=darkgray}} [[Partidong Pagbabago ng Palawan|PPPL]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Palawan's 3rd congressional district''' is one of the three [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Palawan]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 2013.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 16, 2021}} The district is composed of the city of [[Puerto Princesa]] and adjacent municipality of [[Aborlan]].{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=10171|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2012/07/19/republic-act-no-10171-2/ |title=An Act Reapportioning the Province of Palawan Into Three (3) Legislative Districts |date=July 19, 2012 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)|Official Gazette of the Republic of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 16, 2021}} It was created after the 2012 [[reapportionment]] that redrew the boundaries of the [[Palawan's 2nd congressional district|2nd district]] and allocated a new district for Palawan's capital and only city. The district is represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Gil Acosta Jr.]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]] (Lakas) and [[Partidong Pagbabago ng Palawan]] (PPPL).{{cite web|url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 25, 2023}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
